scorecard.venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad

batting.name: JM Sharma
batting.dismissal: c AK Markram b M Jansen

batting.name: SM Curran
batting.dismissal: c B Kumar b M Markande

batting.name: Sikandar Raza
batting.dismissal: c MA Agarwal b Umran Malik

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c SM Curran b RD Chahar

balls.text: thigh high full toss on off stump, shuffles across his stumps and heaves this high and deep 10 rows back over midwicket into the stands. Shikhar scores more than two-thirds of Punjab's runs to give them a fighting chance. Preity Zinta is on her feet in the owner's box applauding his effort.
low full toss on leg stump at knee height, tries to reverse swat this and picks out short third man on the ring for none.
yorker on off, jammed out to the point sweeper and he turns down another single because two wasn't possible.
yorker on the legs, shuffles across and sweeps this straight to deep fine leg and he turns down another single to protect Rathee.
length ball on the stumps, heaved to wide long-on for two.
full on off, reverse paddles this but picked out backward point for none.
full on the legs, flicked wide of deep fine leg, they could've possibly run two but Shikhar turns down the single to not risk the two and ensures he keeps the strike for the final over.
short ball on the stumps, pulled gently through square leg for one.
good length ball on seventh stump, shuffles across and reverse shovels this past short third to the rope.
good length ball on fifth stump, slices a cut behind point and beats deep third man to the rope.

dropped! Bhuvi has spilled three chances by Shikhar, including two off his own bowling!  Low full toss at shin height on the stumps, punched back low to Bhuvi and fumbled through his legs reaching low and forward at shin height.
back of a length following Shikhar backing way outside leg and he fights this off into cover for none turning down another single.
back of e length on the body, tap and run into midwicket for one.
short on the legs, top edges another pull short swirling towards deep fine leg but clears Bhuvi by five yards this time.
146 kph length ball on fourth stump, goes to pull and it skids a touch low under the shot.
half-volley on seventh stump, strokes this 145 kph delivery high and wide of long-off one bounce over the rope.

dropped! Short ball on the stumps, top edge swirls to Bhuvi at deep fine leg. Bhuvi is in an awful tangle trying to get under this, overruns the ball then tries to overcorrect back to his left and spills the ball reaching across his body before it lands over the rope.
short and wide on seventh stump, slices a cut straight to the sweeper and they turn down the single.
back of a length on the stumps, goes back to flick and misses off the body. LBW shout denied. They take a leg bye. Markram wants to review this but he's just burned his last review on the wide call.

bouncer on fourth stump left alone. Wide called. Sunrisers review this because they want the over to end so that Rathee will be on strike. Side angle replay shows it's clearly sailing over. Review lost.
back of a length on fifth stump, hops back and opens the face to guide this to deep third for one.
fullish length on the stumps, tapped into midwicket and they opt to take a single to put Rathee on strike for the first time.
dropped! Misfires the yorker on fourth stump at knee height as a full toss. Tamely spooned back to Bhuvi at waist height at a gentle pace but he fumbles it badly.
half-volley on the legs, flicked past short fine leg to the rope. Shikhar now has taken the orange cap for the IPL scoring lead.
yorker on middle, jammed out back to Bhuvi.
full on seventh stump at 130 kph, shovels this just wide of extra cover to take a single to long-off to keep the strike.
how impressive is this?! Thigh high full toss on an attempted yorker on fifth stump, Shikhar shuffles across and scoop/ramps this over fine leg and it goes all the way to clear the rope.
length ball on middle, Shikhar latches on and heaves this high and deep into the sixth row over midwicket, half-century comes up off 42 balls for Shikhar.
knee high full toss on fourth stump, slapped to long-off, another single turned down.
good length ball on seventh stump, Shikhar shuffles across trying to reverse paddle this through third man but can't beat the field and they turn down another single.
full on fifth stump, driven to long-on but Shikhar is already turning down singles to protect the No. 11.

drag on with a reverse sweep! Great day to be a leggie in the IPL. Googly flighted full on fourth stump spins in, Ellis crouches low trying to reverse paddle this behind point and it comes off the glove, then the thigh onto the stumps. Bizarre shot to play when Shikhar is begging for someone to hang with him.
full on the legs, sweeps this firmly to deep backward square leg for one.
charges a flighted ball on fifth stump, smashes this high over the bowler, one bounce four.
full on fourth stump, smothered on the front foot.
short on middle, goes to pull and misses off the thigh, stifled lbw shout.
full on middle, goes to flick through midwicket and a leading edge goes to backward point for none.
good length on fourth stump at 144 kph, guided to deep third for one with an open face.
short on fifth stump at 144 kph, Ellis tennis backhands this into the ground back to Umran.
full on leg stump at 144 kph follows Ellis backing away flicking to midwicket for none.
back of a length on the hips, late flicking this off the thigh and deflects to deep fine leg for one.
back of a length on the body, goes to pull and is hit on the body for none.
length ball at 147 kph on sixth stump, slices this cut very fine to beat deep third man on the rope.
full on sixth stump, prodded to mid-off for none.

full on fourth stump, shuffles across to sweep and misses, big lbw shout upheld. This looked iffy live. Chahar calls for a DRS review. Main doubt was whether he was hit in line with off stump or outside the line. He was hit low on the back thigh in the crouching position. Ball-tracking shows impact is "umpire's call" so the decision stays on field.
good length ball defended to the off side.
length ball on fifth stump, opens the face to try to guide this past slip but the fielder dives to stop this on a bounce denying a single.
flighted full on fourth stump, defended.
good length ball slapped through point for one.

back of a length over leg stump, Chahar shuffles well across his stumps to pull and misses, no wide called. Kings have bizarrely reviewed this wanting a wide called. Not sure why you'd want to face Umran for an extra ball at 150 kph. Third umpire declares the batter shuffled too far and it's not a wide so Kings lose a review.
back of a length on the stumps, defended again.
good length ball on off, defended.
dropped! Full and searing just past leg stump at 149 kph, slight deflection going down the leg side. Huge appeal from Umran given not out because the keeper has shelled this diving to his left.
bullseye! Length ball angled into middle stump at 148 kph, Harpreet is just not quick enough getting the bat down in time and this laser destroys middle and leg stump.
length ball on fifth stump, cuts this crisply to the cover sweeper for one.
full on fourth stump, punched firmly to long-off for another single.
full on fifth stump, punched to long-off for one.

googly spins in sharply after being flighted on a fullish length at 83 kph on fourth stump, Shahrukh prods down the wrong line and is struck below the knee in front of middle and off. LBW shout upheld. Shahrukh has a brief chat with Shikhar before calling for the review. The only chance he has of being saved is if this was spinning too sharply to miss leg. But ball-tracking shows it is clipping that outside of leg stump with umpire's call keeping it out. But Kings will not lose a review.

flighted full on fifth stump, pokes at this flat-footed and is beaten. Appeal for stumping, though it looked innocuous live. And sure enough the third umpire confirms we've just wasted 30 seconds of our lives we'll never gets back.
good length ball on fifth stump, slapped through cover for one to the sweeper.
flighted on a fullish length on fifth stump, Shikhar gropes at this and is beaten.
151 kph bolt fired down on a good length ball on fourth stump, muscles a drive back past the non-striker and beats mid-off to the rope.

bouncer on middle, Raza tries to lean back to ramp this 142 kph ball over deep third man but he doesn't get enough lumber on it and it carries to the man stationed two yards in from the rope, Mayank Agarwal, taken at chest height.
length ball on seventh stump at 147 kph, pulls this barely clearing mid-on for two.
140 kph length ball on fifth stump, swats this into the ground dribbling short of the non-striker for none.
length ball on fifth stump, punched square through the off side for two.
139 kph back of a length on fourth stump, defended on the back foot to cover.
good length ball zipped down the leg side past a flick at 139 kph. Wide called.
full on middle, ungainly sweep first ball while losing his balance and one-hand slaps this behind square leg for a single.

charges a fullish length ball floated wider again on seventh stump but Curran gets nowhere near the pitch and a googly spinning away results in a miscued drive sliced tamely in the air ballooning to short third man. Simple catch taken by Bhuvi shuffling to his left along the edge of the ring.
googly on a good length on fourth stump spins away and is left alone.
shorter and a touch wider on seventh stump, slapped this behind point and picks the gap well to the rope.
good length ball scuffed into the off side for none.
full outside off, driven down the ground to long-off for one.
fullish length on fourth stump, punches this gently to long-on for one.
good length ball on fifth stump at 132 kph, sliced behind point and beats the fielder diving on the ring before going to the rope.
135 kph length ball on fifth stump sliced to backward point for none.
slower ball at 118 kph lands full on fifth stump, heaves this to deep midwicket for one.
fuller and wider, sliced square to the sweeper for one.
half-volley on off stump, thumps a drive high over the umpire bouncing into the sightscreen for a boundary.
back of a length on fourth stump, punched to Sundar's right and he scurries to field and deny a single.
full on middle, driven to long-on for one.
short on fourth stump, goes back to pull and bottom edges this into his feet for none.
back of a length on fourth stump, punched back to Sundar.
fuller and straighter on the legs, flicked to long-on for one.
short on seventh stump, plenty of width to rock back and punch this through extra cover to the rope.
back of a length on fourth stump at 137 kph, tapped into the covers and sets off for a single before Curran sends him back.
good length ball on middle at 125 kph, defended back down the pitch to the bowler.
missed runout! Back of a length on middle, tap and run for a dicey single behind point and the throw at the striker's end stumps is just wide. If it hit, Shikhar was running straight to the dugout.
good length on middle at 141 kph, defended to mid-off for none.
length ball dragged wider on seventh stump at 137 kph, this time Curran spanks it on the up over extra cover, one bounce over the rope.
length ball on fifth stump sits up for Curran to swat disdainfully over wide long-on 12 rows back.
good length ball on off at 133 kph, defended back to the bowler.
fullish length on the legs, flicked into midwicket for two.

fullish length on fifth stump at 130 kph, drives hard at this and it goes on one bounce to short third man where the fielder fumbles badly while backing away to the short hop and it goes off the leg to the rope.
back of a length on fifth stump, tap and run into extra cover for a tight single.
back of a length on middle at 132 kph, defended to cover.
length ball on off stump, prods this into the covers and sets off for a run.
139 kph ball full on leg stump, defended to extra cover for none.

fullish length ball on fourth stump at 140 kph, Jitesh tries to drive this on the up aiming to clear mid-off but it wasn't full enough for the shot and miscues this flat to the fielder five yards inside the ring at mid-off, Markram the captain taking a chest height catch with ease.
full on fourth stump, driven firmly to mid-off for none.
bouncer over middle, sways under to leave it at 134 kph.
good length ball on off punched firmly straight to short extra cover for none.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended to mid-off for none.
Shikhar shuffles down the track to a full ball on fourth stump and shovels this high over wide mid-off to the rope.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended.
full on off, punched firmly past the non-striker to the mid-off rope.
good length ball on off, defended.
back of a length on fourth stump at 130 kph, comes down the track and defends to cover.
good length ball seams across Shikhar on off stump at 128 kph and beats him poking at it.
full and swinging into middle, defended back to Jansen again.
full and swinging into fourth stump, stabbed back to Jansen.
full and wide at 141 kph, stabs at this and a thick edge goes to the third man rope.

full and swinging into the legs beating an attempted flick, big lbw shout upheld. This was very marginal compared to the others. DRS review taken immediately. The major doubt was whether or not this would still be hitting leg stump or if it is going past but it's definitely not going over the top because he was hit well below the knee roll. Sure enough this is swinging well down leg stump on ball-tracking, decision overturned.

and now it is the carbon copy of the first-ball wicket! Good length swinging into middle past a heave across the line, Short is struck above the knee roll on the back leg but his leg is bent flexing on the shot. This looks pretty dead and Bruce Oxenford gives it out fairly quickly after the appeal from Jansen. Short has a long chat with Shikhar before the time expires on the DRS review clock and he walks off.
back of a length swinging into middle and leg past a pull shot, lbw shout denied. Looked very similar to where Prabhsimran was given out but Bruce Oxenford shakes his head not out.
full and swinging sharply down the leg side past an attempted flick, wide called.
good length ball, charges again but it seams away from fifth stump on a good length and is left alone.

fullish length ball on fourth stump, Shikhar shuffles down the track and just smothers the ball with a gentle punch in front of point that is timed superbly to beat the ring fielder's diving effort and beat deep third man circling around unable to stop it before the rope.
good length ball on the legs, flicked through the leg side for two.
good length ball on fifth stump angled across at 127 kph and left alone.
Shikhar charges at a length ball that swings sharply outside the wide guideline beyond off stump at 124 kph, left alone and wide called.
back of a length on fourth stump, goes back to defend and a thick edge goes wide of the slips to deep third for one.
full and swinging sharply down the leg side at 131 kph, wide called.

extraordinary finish to the first match and now an extraordinary start to this contest with a wicket first ball! Back of a length delivery nails Prabhsimran above the knee roll but stuck on the crease prodding down the wrong line. He's hit quite high but is deep enough for the umpire to uphold the lbw appeal and Prabhsimran curiously walks straight off without even consulting Shikhar about using a review. It looked quite high on the live shot and the replays too.

Tripathi appropriately finishes the match with another square cut behind point that brings up a 100-run unbeaten partnership sealing an eight-wicket win with 17 balls to spare.  Length ball wide outside off, latches onto this and picks the gap to seal Sunrisers' first win of the 2023 IPL.
full on middle, shovels this high over the bowler, mid-off is up in the ring so this bounces away freely to the rope.
carbon copy! Short and wide on seventh stump again, another sumptuous cut beats backward point and backspins away to the rope.
what placement! Length ball on seventh stump at 135 kph, square cut beats backward point to the rope.
fullish length on fourth stump, driven back to Ellis.
133 kph delivery lands full on fourth stump, goes to drive, inside edge goes past leg stump to the fine leg rope.
slower short ball on fourth stump, cross batted down the ground for one.
length ball wide outside off, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
full on middle, flicks this through wide long-on and immediately calls for two, which they collect quite easily.
120 kph length ball on fourth stump muscled to the cover sweeper for one.
short on fifth stump, smashes a pull into the ground to midwicket for none.
short on fifth stump, opens the face to run this to deep third for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, punched away Dorn the
full and wide on eighth stump, drives this square behind point and beats the sweeper to the rope.
full on sixth stump, now he goes for the reverse sweep slapping it flat over point to the rope.
slogged over midwicket into the fourth row of the second tier! Floated too full on middle and leg, Tripathi slog sweeps this 94 meters deep and there's a scramble in the stands to locate the ball.
good length ball skids on toward middle and leg, fought off down the pitch and the bowler misfields diving in front of the non-striker before the ball dribbles away for one.
full and wide, on eighth stump, drives this inside out over extra cover and beats the cover sweeper to the rope.
good length ball on the stumps, taps in front of point for one but a sloppy throw by Curran to the keeper escapes his diving effort and an overthow is taken to make it two runs.
short on sixth stump, cuts this firmly to backward point where Short dives to stop a boundary.
short and angled into fourth stump, pulled to deep midwicket for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, opens the face to run this to third man for one.
good length ball angled across fifth stump, goes to cut and a bottom edge bounces short of the keeper for none.
bouncer over middle stump, ducked under by Tripathi.
full on fifth stump angled in, driven to long-off for one. 50 partnership comes up.
flighted more and dragged wider almost on the guideline past a drive.
flighted full on middle, launches a drive back over the bowler's head into the sightscreen to bring up a 35-ball half-century.  Chants of "Ra-HUL! Ra-HUL!" break out in the crowd.
length ball on fifth stump, scuffs a cut into the off side for none.
short on sixth stump, cuts this behind point for none.
good length on fifth stump, slapped to the point sweeper for one.
short on the stumps, pulled to deep square leg for one.
back of a length on fourth stump at 133 kph, defended back down the pitch for none.
back of a length on leg stump, Tripathi shuffles across his stumps then back to leg stump before punching into extra cover for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched square to the sweeper for one.
length ball on sixth stump at 132 kph, slices a shot behind point and beats the sweeper to the rope.
back of a length on fourth stump, goes back to flick into square leg for one.
back of a length on fifth stump at 133 kph, tap and run into the covers for one.
full on fifth stump, hammers a sweep through midwicket to the rope.
full on off, sweeps this to short fine leg, Arshdeep tosses a gentle one-bounce relay to Chahar that is fumbled to turn a single into two.

good length ball on fourth stump, pokes at this as the ball spins sharply away. Big appeal for caught behind given not out. The keeper is absolutely convinced. Shikhar is much less so. Chahar seems in between the two. Shikhar waits until there's two seconds left on the timer before calling for DRS.  There was no sound of an edge on the live shot. Replays confirm the same with nothing on Ultraedge. Kings lose a review.
half-volley on fifth stump, smokes a drive flat over extra cover sizzling to the rope.
good length ball on fourth stump, opens the face to guide this straight to short third for none.
full on fifth stump, reaches forward and drives firmly to long-off for one.
full on middle, driven firmly to extra cover for none.
short and wide on seventh stump, slaps this toward Ellis at extra cover sweeper for what should be two, but he slides and kicks the ball into the rope in clumsy fashion.
shot of the day! Fullish length on fifth stump, uses his feet coming down the track lofting this inside out over extra cover and beats wide long-off to the rope.
full outside leg, shuffles across to create a better angle to sweep this fine of the man at short fine leg and beats him cleverly.
full on fourth stump, strikes forward to defend.
back of a length on fifth stump, goes back to tap this into the covers for one.
short on seventh stump, cuts this firmly behind point and beats the sweeper to the rope.
good length ball on fifth stump, opens the face and guides this just wide of slip and it skids away to the rope.
short on fourth stump, slapped to long-on for one.

flighted on a fullish length on fifth stump, he has to reach a long way forward trying to slog this and winds up skying this a mile high toward Curran at long-on. Curran comes in a touch too far stepping in 10 yards from the rope before taking three steps back and swiveling sideways to take this at rib height before falling to the turf to soften the catch with gravity pulling it back sharply to earth.
full on the stumps, driven to long-on for one.
full on fourth stump, pushes this just wide of the bowler to his left and it eludes him for a single.
short on middle, heaves a pull over midwicket for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, tapped into the off side ring for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, goes to cut and it skids a touch low under the shot just missing off stump as it skids on as an arm ball.
back of a length on middle, goes back to punch to the bowler.
good length ball on leg stump, defended to the bowler. Tripathi wanted to attack but changed his shot late.
full on middle, flicked through midwicket for what should be a single. Fielder overruns the ball but they opt not to try to steal a second on a misfield.
flighted slightly fuller than a good length on fifth stump, goes to sweep and misses.
good length ball on fifth stump, prods at this and is beaten by sharp turn.
floated full on off stump, slogs this flat over wide midwicket. Curran runs across 20 yards to his left and leaps up but it barely clears his effort to thud into the bottom of the LCD ad boards.
overpitched on sixth stump, hammers a drive straight to extra cover for none.
shuffles across to a fullish length ball on eighth stump, goes to sweep and misses.
good length ball on off, defended.
bouncer on fourth stump, pulled to deep midwicket for one.
full on fourth stump, driven firmly to mid-off for none.
slower ball back of a length on sixth stump, pulled to deep square leg for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, sliced behind point, diving stop on the ring knocks the ball down to keep it to one.
back of a length on off, slapped back down the pitch and they scamper a tight single to mid-off for one.
full on middle, flicked to midwicket in the ring. Fielder fires at the non-striker's end from 12 yards away with Tripathi straying out and the throw is wide. Would've been tight had it hit.
back of a length on fifth stump at 136 kph, guided to backward point for none.
slower ball lands full outside off at 108 kph, tapped through cover for one.
back of a length on fifth stump at 134 kph, tap and run behind point for one.

dropped! Fullish length ball at 132 kph on fourth stump, sucked into a drive and a thick edge flies low to the keeper's right. His footwork is slow reacting and dives late getting one hand to it at shin height but he can't hold onto it.
good length ball on middle at 134 kph, flicked into midwicket for one.
starts with a slower ball full on middle, defended back to the bowler.
good length ball on sixth stump, left alone shouldering arms.

bullseye! Slower ball knuckle ball angled in from around the wicket at 117 kph on a good length. Brook is through his drive too early and is beaten through the gate. Leg stump cartwheels out of the ground.
low full toss on fifth stump, punched straight to cover for none.
full and wide on eighth stump at 141 kph, gets on a knee to drive and drags this back to mid-on for none.
slower ball at 119 kph lands as a half-volley full on fourth stump, Brook winds up and strokes this crisply in between the non-striker and umpire through mid-off to the rope.
back of a length on fifth stump at 135 kph, Brook backs away from leg stump to create room and slices a cut late behind point through third man to the rope.
quicker ball again full on middle, goes back to punch to long-off for one.
flighted more on a full length on middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
good length ball zipped in a touch quicker on a good length on middle, goes back and stabs this out late to cover for none.
full on middle, punched tentatively to long-off for one.
too short on sixth stump, sits up to be cranked through extra cover to the rope.
full and into the legs, goes to flick and misses off the pads.
good length ball angled into off stump, tapped wide of mid-off for one.

short and angled into the body, Mayank gets inside the line to this 138 kph delivery and pulls it fine of deep backward square leg to the rope. Fine leg was inside the ring so it was placed very safely.
back of a length angled into fourth stump, defended behind point for none.
short on fourth stump at 141 kph, pulls this into the ground fielded on a bounce at midwicket for none.
full on sixth stump at 134 kph, drives firmly and gets it square through point beating the cover fielder diving left to go to the rope.
good length ball angled wide outside off hugging the guideline at 138 kph, left alone and deemed legal inside the line.
slower ball on a good length on fifth stump, drives at this and a thick edge goes to short third man for none.
another slower ball on a good length on fourth stump at 117 kph, defends this to extra cover for none.
back of a length on fifth stump slower ball at 119 kph, adjusts with the hands to defend this to backward point.
full on fifth stump at 130 kph, smokes a drive straight to cover, diving stop on the ring.
129 kph delivery full and swinging in toward fourth stump, punched straight to cover.
full length on sixth stump at 130 kph, drives firmly and beats cover to the rope.
